kind_of_no: presence + price (private, no web presence or rate)
why: Private campground run from Red Wilk Construction's yard (1562 Old Hwy 14 W, Huron; phone 605-352-0735 is the construction company's). Its only description is a third-party paragraph on the City of Huron camping page (https://huronsd.gov/172/Camping, read 2026-11-22: '46 camping spots on hard ground surfaces. All are 30 or 50 amp ... Call Red Wilk at 605-352-0735 for information and reservations'), which posts no rate. No operator website, no booking engine, no RV Life listing (Algolia query + Huron bbox 2026-11-22: only Memorial Park and the State Fairgrounds), not in the Good Sam directory cache; Google Maps (gm.py 2026-11-22) has only 'Red Wilk Construction' at that address, 4.5 on 4 reviews, no website. Fails both private indicators (price and presence), like the 5842 Outback precedent.
name: Red Wilk Campground
flags: The Huron CVB camping page (bids.huronsd.com/visiting-huron/camping) carries the same listing but sits behind a Cloudflare challenge and has no Wayback capture; it was not opened in the browser (search snippets show the same text as the city page, no rate).

Imagery 2026-11-22 at the Google pin (44.37037,-98.24189, north side of Old Hwy 14 W, ~1 km west of the State Fairgrounds): a fenced gravel contractor's yard with buildings and a few parked vehicles/RVs; no laid-out RV rows are evident at this scale. Likely mostly a State Fair-week overflow/long-stay lot - long-stay tests unmeasured.
If AWH wants it anyway, the only route is a phone call (605-352-0735) for rate and nightly sale; not attempted (no phone calls).
